theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_antipodal_ray_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ m : Euclid P → ℤ, R.Represents C → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ e ∈ F, ENNReal.ofReal |(m e : ℝ)| * volume (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) ⁻¹' A)) → ∀ r : ℝ, C.massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) r) = ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ e ∈ F, |(m e : ℝ)|) * r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
